# Saurav Chourasia

> Final-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at VIT Bhopal University (2023–2027, CGPA 8.48/10), based in Bhopal, India. AI Backend Engineer open to full-time AI Engineer, GenAI, and Backend roles.

## Background & Focus
- Started building AI tools to remove workflow friction, which led to realizing dependable LLM applications are mostly backend engineering.
- Currently focused on backend systems, DSA / CS fundamentals, and post-deployment concerns: observability, tracing (LangSmith), cost control, and scaling.

## Experience
- **Software Engineering Intern — eSim AI Assistant**, FOSSEE Summer Fellowship, IIT Bombay (May – Jul 2026, Remote)
  - PR: https://github.com/FOSSEE/eSim/pull/586
  - Replaced raw-netlist LLM prompting with a deterministic Python fact-extraction layer, so the local model explains verified circuit facts instead of inferring topology (side-by-side comparisons judged by a frontier LLM showed more accurate circuit topology descriptions).
  - Engineered a rule-based NgSpice error analysis engine to detect, rank, and suppress cascading errors.
  - Built a hybrid offline workflow surfacing extracted RAG context and structured diagnostics without requiring a local LLM.
  - Integrated the workflow into eSim's Project Explorer.

## Projects
1. **Snip & Ask** (Chrome Extension)
   - Repo: https://github.com/Saura-4/Snip-Ask-Chrome-Extension
   - Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/snip-ask-ai-screen-assist/bhbmfojjmimjpdkebhhipkffjkcglofo
   - Over 1,700+ active users and 75,000+ backend requests served.
   - Self-hosted Cloudflare Worker proxy with D1-backed rate limiting for Guest Mode, OCR-first model routing (text models before vision fallback), BYOK, and Compare Mode.
2. **eSim AI Assistant** (FOSSEE, IIT Bombay)
   - PR: https://github.com/FOSSEE/eSim/pull/586
   - Deterministic netlist fact extraction, rule-based NgSpice error engine, and hybrid offline diagnostics.
3. **Modular RAG & Retrieval Benchmark**
   - Repo: https://github.com/Saura-4/Modular-RAG-Evaluation-Framework
   - Built from scratch with 6 chunking strategies, 4 retrieval strategies, and Recall@k, Precision@k, MRR, and NDCG@k benchmarked on BEIR SciFact, ArguAna, and NFCorpus across Gemini and Ollama.
4. **LLM ChatBot Backend**
   - Repo: https://github.com/Saura-4/llm-chatbot
   - Demo: https://llm-chatbot-blush.vercel.app/
   - Multi-user FastAPI + PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy + Alembic backend with JWT auth, conversation-level authorization, Redis caching, SSE streaming, and Docker.
